title: A Survey on Moral Foundation Theory and Pre-Trained Language Models: Current Advances and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying various methods including prompt engineering with the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ), fine-tuning PLMs on MFT-annotated datasets (like MFTC and MFRC), and analyzing contextual embeddings to extract embedded moral tendencies and judgments.

Evaluating how PLMs replicate political party moral biases by conditioning prompts on political identities (e.g., 'liberal' vs. 'conservative') and analyzing the resulting moral language, as well as examining partisan differences in generated text using moral dictionaries.

Investigating cross-lingual transfer learning to determine if moral standards from dominant languages (e.g., English) are imposed on other cultures, utilizing frameworks like MORALDIRECTION to compare moral value estimations across multilingual models.
